comment: Evidence the delegation gate requires per action. Tiers: 3 the provider's own transcript agrees with the recorded bytes, 2 the kit hook plus its hash-chained ledger with no provider corroboration, 1 a transcript that exists but has not caught up, 0 unverified. Every unknown action, an unreadable file, and a malformed entry all resolve to default_required_tier, so a policy that cannot be read is the strictest policy there is. authority_request names the separate operator-confirmation token an action needs on top of its tier.
